messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging: p99 latency SLO breach detected (Kestrel Retail - dedicated-pool-7 - eu-west-1)
IncidentBot: Alert summary: p95 1.2s -> 3.4s, p99 2.1s -> 8.7s, error rate +0.6% over baseline, sustained for 6m.
Emma Tran: Acknowledged, I'm oncall and joining. Looking at pool dashboards now.
Maya Patel: Seeing sharp inflection at 10:12UTC. Dedicated-pool-7 node gpup-7b-23 shows sustained GPU memory jitter and CPU at 95%.
Diego Ruiz: Any sign of a single tenant causing hot-shard? Pulling request logs.
Emma Tran: Running quick log tail for tenant IDs: `kubectl logs -n rw-serving --tail=200 -l pool=dedicated-pool-7 | grep tenant_`
Emma Tran: Multiple long-lived streaming sessions from tenant_8243 — ~4200 concurrent sessions reported, keepalives every 30s.
Oliver Chen: Kestrel DevOps sent a heads-up earlier about a flash promo 10:00-10:30UTC. Likely correlated.
Sofia Lebedev: Cache metrics show prefix KV hit dropping 82% -> 21% around the same time. High churn on prefix keys.
Diego Ruiz: Likely cache thrash from new prefixes + concurrent sessions. Suggest isolating tenant_8243 to reduce cross-tenant cache pressure.
Emma Tran: Initiating soft-evict of tenant_8243 to warm spare group: `rwctl tenant-evict --tenant tenant_8243 --pool dedicated-pool-7 --mode soft`
Emma Tran: Evict queued; executing. Monitoring impact.
[2m later]
Emma Tran: CPU on gpup-7b-23 dropping 95% -> 78%. p99 trending down to ~4.8s but still above SLO.
Diego Ruiz: While eviction rolls, apply temporary rate limit to tenant to avoid overshoot: `routectl set-rate --tenant tenant_8243 --qps 12 --duration 15m`
Maya Patel: Applied rate limit. Watching error rates and client timeouts.
Emma Tran: p95 now 1.8s, p99 3.9s. Error rates stabilizing. Good initial mitigation.
Oliver Chen: Drafting customer-facing update for CSM: "We're observing elevated inference latency from a surge in checkout traffic tied to a promotional event. We've isolated and temporarily rate-limited the affected tenant to protect overall performance. We're monitoring and will follow up with next steps and timeline to restore full throughput." Any edits?
Sofia Lebedev: Add compliance note: "No customer data left Kestrel's VPC; actions performed were routing and rate-limiting only."
Arthur Nkomo: I'll kick off a targeted trace on the model's kernel selection and prefix expansion for those long sequences — suspect kernel mis-selection for longer-than-expected sequence lengths.
Diego Ruiz: Good call. Also prepare a repro harness on a sample of tenant requests. Could help validate a quantized model fallback if needed.
Emma Tran: Handoff: I need to step into a support call. Diego, please take primary. Leaving runbook notes in thread.
Diego Ruiz: Taking over. Current state: soft-evict initiated, rate-limit 12 qps, p99 3.9s, pool CPU ~72%. I'll watch for 20m and escalate scale if needed.
Emma Tran: Runbook snippet I've left:
``n- Verify pool node CPU/mem and GPU memory contended
- Check cache hit ratio and prefix churn
- Confirm tenant eviction status: `rwctl tenant-status tenant_8243`
- If p99 > 5s for 15m -> scale pool: `scalectl pool dedicated-pool-7 --add 2`
- If regression after eviction -> route 25% to warm-spare: `routectl split --tenant tenant_8243 --buckets 75,25 --target pool:warm-spare-eu1b`
- Notify CSM + SOC; prepare customer note
``
Diego Ruiz: Enabled extra tracing for prefix cache keys for 15m. Also opening a short-lived sampling of request bodies (PII-safe sampling rules applied).
[10m later]
Maya Patel: Warm spare in eu-west-1-b is healthy; we can route a fraction if eviction/rate limit fails.
Diego Ruiz: Standby. If p99 > 5s we'll split 25% traffic to warm spare.
Oliver Chen: CSM approved the customer message, sending now. Keeping message conservative: mention mitigation steps and that we're monitoring.
Diego Ruiz: p99 has stabilized at 2.8s for the past 6m, p95 ~1.3s. Dropping alert severity to advisory. Keeping watch for 30m with automated rollback rules.
IncidentBot: Incident record created/updated: INC-2026-3998765432 — Priority P1 escalated -> P2 partial mitigation achieved.
Sofia Lebedev: Post-incident action items to capture:
- Define tenant auto-isolation thresholds for dedicated pools
- Improve cache pre-warming for new prefix patterns
- Capacity planning for promo burst scenarios (runbook + limits)
- Add model fallback (quantized variant) for long sequences in hot tenants
Emma Tran: +1, I'll open an RFC for thresholds and autoscaling policy changes.
Oliver Chen: I'll coordinate a debrief with Kestrel ops + CSM next week.
Diego Ruiz: Handoff complete. Monitoring continues for another 30m; ping me on-call if we see regression. Closing primary war-room at 20:40UTC unless otherwise noted.
Arthur Nkomo: Trace dump link: https://internal.rw/trace/3998765432 (obfuscated traces, access controlled)
Emma Tran: Nice job team :thumbsup:
